engineNotes: Match keywords on word boundaries. Without this, 'trai' matches 'train' and 'sbi' matches parts of other words. A keyword that starts or ends with a symbol such as '.apk' needs no boundary on that side.
Skip a keyword match if a negation word appears in the 40 characters before it. Do not apply this to rule R10, whose keywords are themselves negations.
Keyword rules also scan the text of links, so 'sbi-kyc-update.xyz' can match R02 and R03. This is acceptable and the expected results below allow for it.
Compare the engine's output to expected.level and expected.pattern first. Treat score as correct if within the scoreMin and scoreMax range.

scenarios.title: Government benefit, APK, OTP (deck example)

messages.text: Your PM Kisan benefit is pending. Complete verification today to receive it.
Install this app to continue: http://pmkisan-help.xyz/verify.apk
Enable permissions and enter your OTP to get the money.

scenarios.demoNote: Main demo. Mirrors the deck: benefit, install app, permissions and OTP. Show the risk meter rising message by message.

scenarios.title: Electricity bill disconnection (Hinglish)

messages.text: Dear customer, aapka bijli bill pending hai. Aaj raat 9:30 baje connection kat jayega.
Turant is number par call karein: 98xxxxxx12. Ya link par click karein: bit.ly/pay-bill
Bill update ke liye AnyDesk install karein aur 10 rupaye processing fee bhejiye.

scenarios.demoNote: Shows Hinglish support and a pressure-to-remote-access path.

scenarios.title: Fake bank KYC with lookalike link

messages.text: SBI Alert: Your KYC has expired. Account will be blocked today.
Update now: http://sbi-kyc-update.xyz
Enter your card number, CVV and the OTP sent to your phone.

scenarios.demoNote: Shows lookalike domain detection. The domain sbi-kyc-update.xyz should also appear in seed reports so campaign correlation can find it.

scenarios.title: Digital arrest / fake authority

messages.text: This is Inspector Sharma from Cyber Cell. A parcel in your name has drugs. Case registered.
Do not tell anyone and do not disconnect the call. Arrest warrant will be issued.
To clear your name, transfer Rs 25,000 to the safe account now.

scenarios.demoNote: Shows fear and secrecy tactics. Note that no link is involved, so sequence logic matters more than URL checks.

scenarios.title: Part-time task / registration fee scam

messages.text: Part time job! Earn daily Rs 3000 from home. Just complete tasks and like and subscribe videos.
Click here to join: https://tinyurl.com/earn-now
Pay Rs 500 registration fee to activate your account and receive commission.

scenarios.demoNote: Shows that the same pattern appears in job and task scams.

scenarios.title: Fake refund with UPI collect request

messages.text: Congratulations! Your refund approved: Rs 4,999 will be credited to you.
Accept the UPI collect request on your Google Pay to receive it.

scenarios.demoNote: Shows a SUSPICIOUS result that is not HIGH, which proves the levels are not all-or-nothing.

scenarios.title: SIM block threat then OTP (Hinglish)

messages.text: Aapka SIM kal band ho jayega. Turant verify karein.
Verification ke liye apna OTP bhejiye.

scenarios.demoNote: Shortest example of a HIGH result: two messages. Good for a quick live demo.

scenarios.title: Genuine bank alert (benign)

messages.text: HDFC Bank: Rs 1,250 debited from your account ending 4521 on 28-Oct. If not you, call the number on the back of your card.
OTP for your transaction is 482913. Do not share OTP with anyone. - HDFC Bank

scenarios.demoNote: Must-show benign case. A genuine bank alert says 'Do not share OTP', so negation handling must keep this LOW.

scenarios.title: Weak evidence (Can't confirm)

messages.text: Hello, this is from your bank regarding your account.
Your KYC is pending. Please update it when you can.

scenarios.demoNote: Shows the explicit Can't confirm outcome when evidence is weak.
